Henderson St..why: Henderson St is the old name of Marin Blvd. The GIS layer's Marin Blvd segment has the same Monday 1-2 pm, both-sides rule the schedule gives Henderson St.

River Terrace.why: The GIS layer labels River Terrace as River St north of 5th St. Its geometry matches OpenStreetMap's River Terrace, and its Wed/Thu rules match the schedule's River Terrace rows.

location_fixes.why: Newark St runs east-west, so 'north boundary' can only mean the east end. The GIS layer has the same Fri 8-9 am rule east of Washington St.
17th St isn't in the GIS layer; Clinton St's segments end just north of 16th St.
